# Jordan Betts - Developer Portfolio

> A developer portfolio and collection of interactive learning and computer science projects by Jordan Betts.

## Main pages

- [Portfolio home](https://jordanb.io/)
- [HTML and CSS study deck](https://jordanb.io/learn)
- [Chess engine](https://jordanb.io/chess)
- [Sorting visualizer](https://jordanb.io/sorting)
- [Fractal renderer](https://jordanb.io/fractal/)

## About the site

The portfolio describes Jordan's experience, technology stack, projects, and contact details. The learning area provides an interactive spaced-repetition flashcard system for HTML and CSS. The other project pages demonstrate browser-based algorithms and visualizations.

## Usage

Public pages may be indexed and summarized. When referencing the site, link to the most specific page listed above.
